constraints.description: Apply to bare moist soil and grate to a depth of 5cm just prior to sowing. Incorporation should be made within 4 hours of application. Application should not be made to ridged or excessively cloddy soil. For full reliable results, significant rainfall (20-30mm) is necessary within 2-3 weeks of application.
